criteria.name: orchestration_invocation_after_all_sprints_pass
criteria.description: After all sprints pass in runSprintLoop(), the Documenter agent (runDocumenter) is invoked automatically before the harness returns its final result. The call must pass workDir, the resolved documenter model (modelDocumenter ?? model), isGreenfield, logLevel, documenter-routed skills, sourceDir, testDir, and sprintResults.

criteria.name: documenter_invoked_on_resume_success
criteria.description: When --resume is used and all remaining sprints pass (allPassed === true), the Documenter is also invoked. Both the fresh-run and resume paths go through runSprintLoop, so the documenter call must be in runSprintLoop (not in runHarness or resumeHarness individually).

criteria.name: documenter_failure_does_not_fail_harness
criteria.description: If the Documenter agent throws an error, the harness catches it, logs a warning containing the word 'warning' (case-insensitive), and still returns success (HarnessResult.success === true) with exit code 0. progress.json still shows status 'complete'.

criteria.name: documenter_tracing_span
criteria.description: When tracing is enabled, the Documenter runs within a tracing span named 'documenter' (or containing 'documenter') that is a child of the parentSpan passed to runSprintLoop. The span is ended after the Documenter completes (including on error).

criteria.name: documenter_usage_recorded
criteria.description: After the Documenter completes successfully, its SDK result is recorded via usage.recordStage() with a stage name containing 'documenter'. This cost appears in usage.json alongside other stages.

criteria.name: documenter_skipped_on_dry_run
criteria.description: When --dry-run is set (config.isDryRun === true), the Documenter is NOT invoked. The dry-run exits before runSprintLoop is called, so the documenter code path is never reached.

criteria.name: documenter_skipped_on_sprint_failure
criteria.description: When any sprint fails (allPassed === false), the Documenter is NOT invoked. The harness exits with its normal failure path and progress.json shows status 'failed'.

criteria.name: no_docs_cli_flag_parsed
criteria.description: A --no-docs CLI flag is accepted by parseCli() in config.ts via parseArgs options and mapped to a 'noDocs' boolean field in ParsedCli. The parseArgs strict mode does not throw when --no-docs is passed. Default is false.

criteria.name: no_docs_env_var_support
criteria.description: When ADHD_NO_DOCS=1 (or any truthy value like 'true') is set in the environment and no --no-docs CLI flag is given, the resolved config has noDocs === true. The --no-docs CLI flag takes precedence: if --no-docs is explicitly passed, that value wins regardless of the env var.

criteria.name: no_docs_config_in_harness_config
criteria.description: HarnessConfig in types.ts includes an optional noDocs?: boolean field. resolveConfig() populates it from CLI > env > default (false).

criteria.name: no_docs_prevents_documenter_invocation
criteria.description: When config.noDocs is true and all sprints pass, the Documenter is not invoked, no documenter tracing span is created, and no documenter-related log output appears. The harness still returns success.

criteria.name: model_documenter_cli_flag
criteria.description: A --model-documenter CLI flag is accepted by parseCli() and mapped to modelDocumenter in ParsedCli. It is added to resolveConfig() following the same pattern as --model-planner/--model-generator/--model-evaluator (CLI > env > undefined).

criteria.name: model_documenter_fallback_to_base
criteria.description: When --model-documenter is not specified and MODEL_DOCUMENTER is not set, the Documenter uses the base --model value. The modelDocumenter field in HarnessConfig is optional and defaults to undefined, with the harness falling back to the base model at call site (config.modelDocumenter ?? model).

criteria.name: model_documenter_env_var
criteria.description: MODEL_DOCUMENTER environment variable (matching the existing convention of MODEL_PLANNER, MODEL_GENERATOR, MODEL_EVALUATOR without ADHD_ prefix) is read in resolveConfig() and used when no --model-documenter CLI flag is provided.

criteria.name: documenter_git_commit_enforcement
criteria.description: After the Documenter agent completes successfully, a commit enforcement check runs. It captures HEAD SHA before the documenter runs and compares after. If the working tree is dirty (agent did not commit), a fallback auto-commit is performed with a message containing '[docs]'. This may reuse ensureGeneratorCommit or implement equivalent logic.

criteria.name: documenter_agent_commit_detected
criteria.description: If the Documenter agent commits on its own (HEAD SHA changed compared to the pre-documenter SHA), no fallback commit is made. The commit source is logged.

criteria.name: docs_commit_message_prefix
criteria.description: Fallback auto-commits made for the Documenter use a commit message that contains '[docs]' to distinguish documentation commits from feature commits (which use '[sprint-N]') in git history.

criteria.name: documenter_skills_routing
criteria.description: Skills are routed for the documenter agent using routeSkillsForAgent(resolvedSkills, 'documenter') (or equivalent), and the routed skills are passed to runDocumenter. If no skills match the documenter route, an empty/default AgentSkills is passed.
